description: Re-runs AI generation for an existing policy, using its stored business details merged with the changed fields provided. The policy ID and hosted URL stay the same, so published links keep working, and the previous content is saved as a version first. Suited to substantial changes such as new integrations, a new jurisdiction or a renamed company. Uses one document from the account's quota. If it is not finished within about 45 seconds, the tool returns a job ID instead of the document and the job keeps running.

children_data.description: Does it knowingly collect data from children?

cookies.description: Does it use cookies? Defaults to true for most websites.

data_collection.description: Categories of personal data collected, e.g. ["email","name","usage"].

data_retention.description: How long data is kept, e.g. "24 months".

dpo_email.description: Data Protection Officer email, if any. Also sets hasDPO.

governing_law.description: Governing law jurisdiction, e.g. "State of California, USA".

sells_data.description: Does it sell or share personal data?

service_description.description: Short description of what the product or service does.

stack_manifest.description: Structured summary of the services and data the product uses, e.g. {"analytics":["posthog"],"payments":["stripe"],"auth":["supabase"],"ai_features":["openai"],"cookies":["session"],"jurisdiction_signals":["EU locales"]}. Stored with the policy so later changes to the stack can be detected.

table_of_contents.description: Add a linked table of contents to the generated document. Requires a Pro plan.

user_accounts.description: Does the product have user accounts?

name: regenerate_policy
title: Regenerate policy
